name: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd
title: Artemis Medicare Services Ltd - 542919 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gurgaon occupancy 64.6% with 546 beds; Raipur 300-bed capex INR 110-120 crores and INR 18-20 crores loss in first 18 months, ROCE target 16-18% on new capital. Supply additions are company-led, with no peer capacity commentary.

utilisation.quote: our flagship hospital in Gurugram continues to deliver strong performance with occupancy level reaching 64.6% in Q4

capex.peers_comment: Raipur market: 'every tertiary and quaternary private player is looking at' it; Manipal and Lilavati buying land or signing MOUs
capex.quote: it will be between INR 110 to INR 120 crores is the capex for a 300 bed facility

triggers.label: Raipur 300 beds, INR 110-120 cr capex
triggers.quote: it will be between INR 110 to INR 120 crores is the capex for a 300 bed facility

triggers.label: Gurgaon beds open at 70% occupancy trigger
triggers.quote: The moment we have 70% occupancy for a quarter, we are going to be opening 50 then another 50 beds.

triggers.label: Domestic and international price hikes 15%
triggers.quote: We take a 15% hike, even in the next budget we have taken a 15% hike on our top line

guidance.quote: over a period of three to four years you can take at least 15 % to 17% growth on the revenue front
whatever numbers, whatever revenue that gets added to the top line, at least 30% will flow down to the EBITDA
Gurugram facility will see EBITDA northwards of 20% if not more in the coming years
there would be close to INR 18 crores to INR 20 crores of losses from Raipur

guidance.value: Q1 FY27, 300 beds in two quarters
guidance.quote: in two quarters you can expect all 300 beds operational

guidance.value: 16% to 18% in next three to five years
guidance.quote: any new capital which is being deployed, we look anywhere between 16% to 18% ROCE in the next three to five years
we're looking it to move to touch 70 if not exceed it

guidance.metric: Peak debt for Raipur and Delhi
guidance.quote: the maximum peak debt would be close to INR 350 crores that we will have to take

red_flags.label: Raipur losses and 15-month margin drag
red_flags.quote: So that overall mix will be putting the EBITDA maybe a 1% to 1.5% lower because of these losses.

red_flags.label: Cash flow conversion questions left offline
red_flags.quote: But any other question or clarification, we can take it offline, yeah, because we'll have to check these numbers and we don't want to give a wrong number.

evasions.topic: Cash flow from operations and conversion
evasions.quote: We've Seen CFO come off for the full year versus last year.
so some we do n't want to give numbers as such because that would be incorrect
